<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915996_theRebbe_995" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915996_theRebbe_995__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the header information for the maamar, including the Torah portion, date, and year.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos Parshas Vayeitzei,</t>
    <t s="2">the 9th of Kislev,</t>
    <t s="3">the year 5732*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the maamar is an unedited discourse.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">(An unedited discourse)</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section introduces the phrase "You are One" and questions the unique superiority of the Minchah prayer on Shabbat over all other prayers.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"You are One"</t>
    <t s="1">and Your Name is One, and who is like Your people Israel, one nation in the land, etc.</t>
    <t s="2">Now, this text is recited during the Minchah prayer of Shabbat,</t>
    <t s="3">the ratzon of ratzonot (the will of wills).</t>
    <t s="4">And it is necessary to understand what is the virtue of the Minchah prayer of Shabbat over all prayers,</t>
    <t s="5">even over</t>
    <t s="6">(the other)</t>
    <t s="7">prayers of Shabbat itself,</t>
    <t s="8">that specifically then we say "You are One," etc., which speaks about the Holy One, Blessed be He, Himself.</t>
    <t s="9">And particularly according to what is explained in the discourse on this topic by the Baal HaHilula (the master of the celebration),</t>
    <t s="10">that in this text are explained all the levels in Atzilus and above Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="11">all aspects of Hishtalshelus (the chain of descent) and that which is above Hishtalshelus.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
